_comment: All tunable scraper settings live here. __init__.py only computes filesystem paths (which a JSON file can't do - there's no equivalent of Python's __file__) and loads these values. Edit this file, not __init__.py, to change ports or worker sizing.

workers._comment: Controls how many concurrent workers (tabs or separate Chrome processes) the scraper auto-selects based on available RAM.
workers._ram_buffer_mb_comment: RAM to always leave free for the OS/other apps, never counted as usable for workers.
workers._estimated_mb_per_tab_worker_comment: Rough memory footprint of one extra tab in an EXISTING browser instance (lighter - shares one Chrome process).
workers._estimated_mb_per_process_worker_comment: Rough memory footprint of one SEPARATE Chrome process worker (heavier, full browser each).
workers._max_workers_cap_comment: Hard ceiling regardless of RAM - avoid hammering WikiHow or exhausting other resources even on a high-RAM machine.
